newsitem.title: USA: Republic to move to New York Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Republic to move to New York Stock Exchange.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc chairman Wayne Huizenga said Tuesday the company's Nasdaq-listed shares would be moved to the New York Stock Exchange within a month.

Huizenga told the company's annual shareholders meeting that Republic's board of directors had voted to list Republic shares on the NYSE, also known as the Big Board and home to many of the United States' leading corporations.
"We expect to be listed with a new symbol in two, three or four weeks," Huizenga said.
The shareholders also voted to triple to 1.5 billion the number of outstanding Republic shares.
